mapper.sql: a.publish_status='PUBLISHED' AND (a.content_origin='ORIGINAL' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_reading_rights r WHERE r.article_id=a.id AND r.rights_status='BLOCKED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_reading_rights r WHERE r.article_id=a.id AND r.rights_status='CLEARED' AND COALESCE(TRIM(r.rights_basis),'')!=''))

sql.where: a.deleted_at IS NULL AND AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%'))AND (a.primary_topic_id IN #{term} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_reading_tag t WHERE t.article_id=a.id AND t.term_id IN #{term}))AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_reading_tag t WHERE t.article_id=a.id AND t.term_id IN #{term})AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_reading_tag t WHERE t.article_id=a.id AND t.term_id IN #{term})

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_english_reading_article a ORDER BY a.published_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.update: UPDATE sr_english_reading_article SET slug=#{slug} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE sr_english_reading_article SET title=#{title},summary=#{summary},body_markdown=#{bodyMarkdown},translation_zh_markdown=#{translationZhMarkdown},primary_topic_id=#{primaryTopicId},source_name=#{sourceName},source_url=#{sourceUrl},content_origin=#{contentOrigin},sort_order=#{sortOrder},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE sr_english_reading_article SET publish_status=#{status},published_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='PUBLISHED' THEN COALESCE(published_at,NOW(3)) ELSE published_at END,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE sr_english_reading_article SET deleted_at=NOW(3),publish_status='WITHDRAWN',row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_english_reading_rights(article_id,source_name,source_url,rights_status,rights_basis,original_author,license_notice) VALUES(#{id},#{sourceName},#{sourceUrl},#{rights.rightsStatus},#{rights.rightsBasis},#{rights.originalAuthor},#{rights.licenseNotice}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_name=#{sourceName},source_url=#{sourceUrl},rights_status=#{rights.rightsStatus},rights_basis=#{rights.rightsBasis},original_author=#{rights.originalAuthor},license_notice=#{rights.licenseNotice}
